  -- has cardinality equal to the sum of the cardinalities of the sets.

  --
  -- We use the lemma that for a finite index type and pairwise disjoint sets,
  -- the cardinality of the union equals the sum of the cardinalities of the sets.
  -- This is a standard result which can be derived using the properties of finite sets and disjoint unions.
  have h : (⋃ i, s i).Finite := Set.finite_iUnion_iff.1 hs
  rw [encard_eq_card] at h
  rw [encard_eq_card]
